subject: website
name: Ollama GUI
summary: A chat interface for models that run on this computer through Ollama, built from upstream's open source (MIT) at a pinned commit, unchanged. It runs only its own files, with no analytics, and may reach only localhost:11434, the user's own Ollama: no other party takes part, which is Level 4. The one step that leaves the computer is optional: Pull has Ollama download a model, and the registry then sees your IP address, so it is not private. The Gravatar avatar option cannot load: the build holds no grant to an outside host.

operations.name: Chat with a model
operations.note: Prompts and replies pass only between this page and the Ollama program on this computer, and are kept in this site's browser storage.

operations.name: List installed models and settings
operations.note: Read from the local Ollama and kept in this site's browser storage.

operations.name: Pull a model
operations.note: Optional, and started by the user. Ollama downloads the model from its registry; the files are checked against their digests, but the registry decides what a name means and sees your IP address.

connections.name: Ollama on this computer (localhost:11434)
connections.note: A program on the same computer, reached over the loopback address. Nothing leaves the computer.

connections.name: Model registry (made by your own Ollama during a pull)
connections.note: Only when the user presses Pull. The page itself never contacts it.
